A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GeCo study and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–E. The reduction from 46 to 45 pages follows acknowledgement relocation and reference reflow, without loss of research material.

before.justification: v3 reports original metric-validation experiments, robustness tests, video-generation benchmarking and guidance experiments in Sections 4–5, with additional qualitative results in Appendix A.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including WarpBench/OccluBench validation, GeCo-Eval benchmarking and guided-generation comparisons.

M1.justification: The motion and structure cues, scale-invariant fusion, temporal aggregation and training-free guidance procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and the implementation appendices. Figure 1's corrected label does not change a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same WarpBench, OccluBench, TartanAir v2 and DL3DV coverage, alongside the four GeCo-Eval scenarios. All 80 evaluation prompts in Appendix E are retained unchanged.

E2.justification: MEt3R, WorldScore and TSED retain their participation in the corresponding quantitative comparisons; SegAnyMo remains in Appendix A's qualitative comparison. The evaluated video-generation models are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The data splits, sample sizes, metrics and evaluation procedures match throughout Sections 4–5 and Appendices B–D. These include the approximately three-second evaluation windows capped at 8 FPS and the 45-prompt guidance comparison.

E4.justification: Both retain the component comparisons, predicted-versus-ground-truth geometry evaluation, real-video noise floor, controlled noise sweeps, motion–consistency analyses and reconstruction case studies. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: The four seeds per GeCo-Eval prompt, seed 42 for TartanAir sampling, mean-and-standard-deviation reporting and Cohen's d analysis are unchanged. No new uncertainty-reporting practice or repeated-run information appears.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged, including the supplementary examples. Table 7 retains fused scores of 0.147 without guidance and 0.135 with guidance; Figure 1 preserves the same examples and diagnostic maps.

T1.justification: The geometric definitions, normalization and fusion equations, guidance formulation, TPS construction and motion-statistic definitions match in Section 3 and Appendices B–D. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about joint artifact detection, interpretable maps, GeCo-Eval benchmarking and training-free guidance. The scope remains geometric consistency in static scenes.

C2.justification: The interpretations of complementary cues, estimator robustness, motion–consistency tradeoffs and spurious object motion are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning dynamic scenes, guidance runtime and dependence on pretrained estimators.

D1.justification: The implementation details, backbone choices, hardware, precision, sampling schedule, hyperparameters and full prompt list remain unchanged. The project URL is also unchanged; the funding acknowledgement is relocated without changing its content.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all reference entries are retained unchanged. Removing the repeated MEt3R citation marker from Table 7 neither removes the cited work nor changes the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: The acknowledgements move from after Appendix E to immediately after Section 6. Figure 1 corrects 'Depth Due' to 'Depth Cue'; otherwise, the scientific prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is re-rendered with different raster resolution and label typography while preserving its panels. Table 7 drops a repeated citation marker and adjusts column spacing, and the acknowledgement relocation reflows the bibliography.

improvement.justification: v5 corrects a figure-label typo and makes small presentation adjustments, but retains the same methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations, including the appendices. These edits provide slight polish without a meaningful change in overall paper quality.
